Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Shaver
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/15/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 489 as introduced requires the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency to suspend an individuals drivers license upon conviction of operation of a vessel while under the influence and to suspend an individuals boating privileges upon conviction of driving under the influence.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
